fusions.name: Snagging Lash
fusions.desc: A thrown barb that deals 14 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at maximum range. It stuns the target for 1 second, makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and slows it by 30% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Tethered Salvo
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Looses 3 barbs, each dealing 6 damage.

fusions.name: Snare Back
fusions.desc: Turns afflictions back on whoever inflicts them: each debuff laid on you has a 45% chance to be sent back to its source instead, for 8 seconds. Fighting beside others pays: +11% per ally within 5.5 tiles, capped at 4.

fusions.name: Latched On
fusions.desc: When you strike, a barb snags the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 5 damage and making it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
